tasks.name: Supplier/vendor discovery & sourcing
tasks.neutral_definition: buyer discovers candidate sellers with trust/availability signals
tasks.preconditions: item spec known; auth where incumbent requires
tasks.observable_outcome: discovery surface or documented supplier discovery workflow

tasks.name: Offer/quote comparison across sellers
tasks.neutral_definition: compare >=2 offers on total cost, lead time, quality, recourse
tasks.observable_outcome: comparison surface or documented RFx/quote comparison

tasks.name: Buyer intent capture with constraints
tasks.neutral_definition: record budget/deadline/quality/delivery/substitute constraints; later shopping respects them
tasks.observable_outcome: persistent intent/constraint surface or documented requisition constraints

tasks.name: Buy-now-vs-wait, price timing, substitution, negotiation
tasks.neutral_definition: act on price/inventory timing or negotiate/substitute within constraints
tasks.observable_outcome: price-tracking/wait mechanics, negotiation or best-offer flow, alternates suggestion

tasks.name: Discover & join existing group buy with visible commitment rules
tasks.neutral_definition: find existing group deal and join/leave with explicit rules
tasks.observable_outcome: group-buy/deal-window surface with explicit commitment rules

tasks.name: Latent-demand group buy: recruit + merchant proposal
tasks.neutral_definition: detect demand, recruit participants, propose group deal to merchant; merchant accepts/rejects/counters

tasks.name: Rent/borrow vs buy
tasks.neutral_definition: compare rental vs purchase: availability, period, deposit, condition, recourse

tasks.name: Resale/consignment of under-used assets
tasks.neutral_definition: list/resell/consign asset with user-controlled pricing; or buy used with condition evidence
tasks.preconditions: asset owned or used market exists
tasks.observable_outcome: seller listing flow or consignment workflow or used channel

tasks.name: Bounded multi-hop trade cycle >=3 participants, per-leg consent
tasks.neutral_definition: execute trade cycle across >=3 participants with per-leg authorization and proof

tasks.name: Procurement: approvals, PO, receiving, invoice matching
tasks.neutral_definition: requisition to approval to PO to partial receiving to invoice matching to credit
tasks.observable_outcome: procurement modules or supplier-portal PO workflow

tasks.name: Orders, fulfilment, delivery/pickup, returns, refunds, recourse
tasks.neutral_definition: order lifecycle incl. returns/refunds and dispute recourse
tasks.observable_outcome: order lifecycle surfaces incl. buyer returns and dispute paths

tasks.name: Storefront/catalog/price/promotion (merchant side)
tasks.neutral_definition: merchant lists products/variants, sets price/promotions, manages storefront
tasks.observable_outcome: merchant admin catalog/pricing/discount docs or demo

tasks.name: B2B/wholesale channel: catalogs, quotes, bulk orders
tasks.neutral_definition: B2B price lists, quotes, bulk ordering, buyer-vendor connections
tasks.observable_outcome: B2B channel documentation or public wholesale marketplace

tasks.name: Inventory, POS, replenishment, multi-location, reconciliation (no-RFID incl.)
tasks.neutral_definition: count/receive/replenish stock, POS checkout, multi-location, reconcile incl. barcode/camera/weighted/file modes

tasks.name: Proactive opportunity discovery
tasks.neutral_definition: surfaced opportunities: price drop, warranty, subscription savings, loyalty, shared logistics
tasks.observable_outcome: documented proactive features (alerts, feeds, savings recommendations)

tasks.name: Trust/safety: fraud handling, evidence, recourse
tasks.neutral_definition: review fraud, counterfeit/wrong-item, refund abuse, evidence trails, dispute resolution
tasks.observable_outcome: documented buyer/seller protection, dispute resolution, fraud controls

tasks.name: User-visible failure/recovery: stale/UNKNOWN, duplicates, idempotency, missing approval
tasks.neutral_definition: stale indicators, UNKNOWN states, duplicate submission handling, approval errors visible to user
tasks.observable_outcome: docs/demos of order state handling, retry, approval errors

tasks.name: Bounded autonomous/assisted store actions under limits
tasks.neutral_definition: assisted purchasing or store operations under budget/margin/approval limits with stop conditions
tasks.observable_outcome: documented agentic/AI purchasing or autonomous replenishment/pricing with limits

tasks.name: What-if/counterfactual commerce planning, non-mutating
tasks.neutral_definition: scenario planning (demand, pricing, inventory) with no canonical state mutation
